```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Merge everything: emigrants + proximity metrics + grooming metrics
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Read proximity metrics (from the earlier script)
proximity_metrics <- read.csv(
  "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data/network_mets_prox_bayes.csv"
)
 
emigrants <- read.csv("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data/All_potential_immigrants_Josie_version.csv")

# Merge proximity into emigrants
emigrants_full <- emigrants %>%
  left_join(
    proximity_metrics %>% select(-group, -start_date, -end_date),
    by = "Code",
    suffix = c("", "_prox")
  )

grooming_metrics<-read.csv("/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data/network_mets_groom_bayes.csv")

# Merge grooming into emigrants
emigrants_full <- emigrants_full %>%
  left_join(
    grooming_metrics %>% select(-group, -start_date, -end_date),
    by = "Code",
    suffix = c("", "_groom")
  )
 
cat("Final merged dataset:", nrow(emigrants_full), "rows,", ncol(emigrants_full), "columns\n")
 

write.csv(emigrants_full,
          "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/Pooja_chapter_matrank/Data/emigrants_full_merged.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)
```
